notes.title: Major Update 1.4.8 New God Effects, Edicts, and Achievements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42278070/48928add89016bfd64ccf2273f9626aa21841ae5.png[/img]

Thank you for your support, ideas, and feedback. We are excited to present update 1.4.8!

[h3]What's new:[/h3]
- Added 28 Steam achievements, some of which are hidden.
- Revamped the edicts window with updated design and navigation (multiple pages available).
- Added new edicts with effects that are constantly active. Some of these have unlockable levels.
- The effects of gods’ favor and wrath are now split into two versions: weak and strong. When reputation declines, the weaker effect is applied first.
- Adjusted the reputation thresholds required to obtain god effects.
- You can now view information about positive and negative god effects in the gods window.

notes.title: Update 1.3.7 New Expedition Events and Quests
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42278070/46e13971b41dce80a2fb1f232e80e9a3fbe46346.png[/img]
Thank you for your support, ideas, and feedback. As we mentioned earlier, work on Grimgrad has resumed, and we are excited to present the latest update!

[h3]What's new:[/h3]
- New events related to heroes from Slavic folklore have been added to the expeditions.
- A Pier and associated buildings have been added to the main storyline.
- The text regarding the return from expeditions has been expanded.
- A problem with item loss during expeditions has been fixed.
- The method of randomizing background music and expeditions has been changed.
- A bug related to demolishing buildings without permission has been fixed.

notes.title: Major Update 1.3. Expeditions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42278070/39bef42bdf6ccbe815c583e02f4a40fc3642d10b.png[/img]

Thank you for your support, ideas, and feedback. As we mentioned earlier, work on Grimgrad has resumed, and we are excited to present another update!

[h3]Expeditions:[/h3]
- Expeditions have been added to the game: a group of your residents will set off on sea adventures in search of goods, treasures, and new lands.
- To prepare for an expedition, you'll need a special building called the Pier, as well as a certain amount of food, wood, and tools. Plan carefully what to take with you so that your sailors can survive and return with rewards!
- In the expedition journal, you can track the events that occurred with your group, the condition and repair of the ship, as well as the resources found and lost.
- Expeditions are divided into three levels. In the early stages, you'll encounter small rewards, but you can upgrade the Pier to the Shipyard and the Harbour, as well as additional buildings like the Cartographer and the Sailors' Academy. All of this will give you access to more distant locations with better rewards and assist you in certain events.
- In the expedition journal, you can send your sailors home at any time. Sometimes it’s better to settle for a little than to risk it all and lose everything. The return journey is shorter and safer.

[h3]Other changes:[/h3]
- Fixed layer display issues with some characters and services.
- Fixed layer hiding issues.
- Fixed the bug with the Koschey egg event.
- Minor improvements in the Save Load window.

notes.title: Update 1.2.5. New Events, Music, and Other Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42278070/a6e3a1b02665eddad76fb5dfa2168d6be705b0ba.png[/img]
Thank you for your support, ideas, and feedback. Work on Grimgrad has resumed, and we will soon announce a major content update!

[h3]Update 1.2.5. Changelog:[/h3]
- Added 7 new events with detailed stories.
- Some events now feature sound effects for enhanced immersion.
- The in-game music has been completely overhauled, with over 40 new tracks added (2.5 hours of atmospheric music).
- Increased maximum camera zoom out.
- The initial camera positions in the levels have been adjusted for better convenience.
- Added x10 speed option.
- Quest display has been improved. It's now easier to track descriptions and statuses across multiple tasks simultaneously.
- The game will pause upon loading a save.
- Added more options for setting a maximum FPS limit.
- The positioning and 3D sound of the settlement have been corrected.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3. Changelog
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42278070/5f050acd2a850f650b9f04334722884ce1bad5dc.png[/img]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new map with two difficulty modes.
[*] Added 14 new events on the new map.
[*] Some fixes and improvements in text and interface phrases.
[*] Improved control - all windows are closed on ESC.
[*] Added Chinese, French, Spanish.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed building demolition bug - demolition confirmation is now required for important buildings.
[*] Fixed minor text and layout errors.
[*] Fixed some errors in translations.
[/list]

Thanks for your support and feedback! Thanks to you, the game will get better with every update.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42278070/1388be1f9e1b44489533e6edd130c13ab6aba8f7.jpg[/img]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
- Added 8 new music tracks. Now the musical accompaniment in the 4th and 5th tales will be more diverse.
- Added language change to game settings.
- In the druzhinnik outpost, the checkmarks were replaced with crosses for greater clarity.
- Some fixes and improvements in phrases of text and interface.
- Improved display of some characters in latin fonts.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed a critical error due to which some types of resources could sometimes not be delivered to houses from the market.
- Fixed a critical error with a storm, as a result of which the ability to build was sometimes completely broken.
- Fixed an error due to which interfaces could not fit in non-standard screen resolutions.
- Fixed an error due to which problem icons could climb on the menu button.
- Fixed an error due to which it was difficult to select a druzhinnik outpost if people were passing through it.

Thanks for your support and feedback! Thanks to you, the game will get better with every update.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42278070/6d730c66e0f16456c7cdebdbac31edcc920246ee.png[/img]

[h2]Changelog. Update 1.0.1[/h2]

- Added Spanish translation. If you would like to play Grimgrad in your language and want to help with the translation, please write to us at support@juvty.com


[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
- Added a visual display of migration information to better understand the problem of why new settlers are not coming.
- Now any windows in the game can be closed with the Esc key.
- The window of gods and decrees is now also closed by a second click.
- Burial place is now called Cesspool. The graphics of the building and the worker associated with it have also been changed.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed a bug with the name of idols in English.
- Fixed display of iron ore layer.
- Fixed some images related to the plot and characters.

Thanks for your support and feedback! Thanks to you, the game will get better with every update.
